plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Skill that rewrites AI-sounding prose to remove common AI writing patterns (imported from blader/humanizer, MIT)

plugins.name: plain-direct-voice
plugins.description: Skill that writes and edits blog posts and essays in a plain, direct voice

plugins.name: writing-quorum-review
plugins.description: Skill that reviews a blog post or essay with four models in parallel and applies only the findings a quorum agrees on

plugins.name: chatgpt-image
plugins.description: Skill that generates raster images with ChatGPT in the browser, one image per prompt, and saves each one into the project

plugins.name: scout
plugins.description: A read-only Haiku code scout subagent, and a gate hook that sends the main thread's code searches and large reads to it

plugins.name: ts7-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript and JavaScript code intelligence from the language server built into TypeScript 7's tsc (tsc --lsp)

plugins.name: csharp-ls-lsp
plugins.description: C# code intelligence from csharp-ls, loading the solution nearest the project root and never one inside .claude/worktrees

plugins.name: yaml-lsp
plugins.description: YAML diagnostics from yaml-language-server, checking GitHub Actions workflows, Compose files and Dependabot config against their SchemaStore schemas
